title: Pure Ultimate Insect
summary: The Ultimate Insect LV archetype (Ultimate Insect LV1, LV3, LV5, and LV7) is a WIND Insect evolution strategy where each stage weakens the opponent's entire board once evolved by its predecessor! When Ultimate Insect LV5 is Special Summoned by the effect of Ultimate Insect LV3 (or Level Modulation), it continuously reduces the ATK of ALL monsters your opponent controls by 500; when LV5 evolves into Ultimate Insect LV7 during your next Standby Phase, LV7 reduces both the ATK AND DEF of all monsters your opponent controls by 700 (putting LV7 at an effective 3300 ATK threshold in combat!). Accelerate the evolution chain with Level Up! and Insect Imitation, while Inzektor Picofalena equips Gokipole and Parasite Paranoid directly from your Deck to search your Insects and cheat out Ultimate Insect LV7 from your hand!

allow.Resonance Insect: Level 4 EARTH Insect that adds any Level 5 or higher Insect monster (Ultimate Insect LV5 or Ultimate Insect LV7!) from your Deck to your hand whenever sent from the field to the GY (such as by Insect Imitation or Inzektor Picofalena!), and sends Gokipole from Deck to GY when banished.
allow.Gokipole: Level 3 EARTH Insect (equipped from Deck by Inzektor Picofalena!) that adds any Level 4 Insect monster (Resonance Insect or Pinch Hopper!) from your Deck to your hand when sent to the GY.
allow.Pinch Hopper: Level 4 EARTH Insect (searchable by Gokipole!) that Special Summons ANY Insect monster from your hand (including Ultimate Insect LV5 or Ultimate Insect LV7!) whenever it is sent from your field to the GY—and if Pinch Hopper is sent to the GY during your Standby Phase to summon LV3 or LV5, that Ultimate Insect immediately activates its Standby Phase effect to evolve into LV5 or LV7 on that very same Standby Phase!
allow.Parasite Paranoid: Level 2 EARTH Insect Quick-Effect handtrap: equips to an opponent's monster to turn it into an Insect and prevent it from attacking your Ultimate Insects; and when sent from the field to the GY while equipped, Special Summons any Level 7 or higher Insect monster (Ultimate Insect LV7!) from your hand, ignoring its summoning conditions!
allow.Insect Imitation: Normal Spell: tributes 1 monster you control (Tributing Level 2 Parasite Paranoid summons Level 3 Ultimate Insect LV3 from your Deck; Tributing Level 4 Resonance Insect triggers Resonance Insect's search AND summons Level 5 Ultimate Insect LV5 from your Deck!).
allow.Cocoon of Ultra Evolution: Quick-Play Spell that tributes 1 Insect on EITHER field equipped with an Equip Card (an opponent's monster equipped with Parasite Paranoid, or your Insect equipped by Inzektor Picofalena!) to Special Summon an Insect from your Deck, and shuffles an Insect from your GY into the Deck to draw 1 card!
allow.Inzektor Picofalena: Link-2 WIND Insect that discards 1 card to equip Gokipole, Resonance Insect, or Parasite Paranoid directly from your Deck to an Insect you control, and shuffles 3 Insects from your GY into the Deck to draw 1 card.
allow.Seraphim Papillion: Link-3 WIND Insect boss that gains counters and banishes 1 counter as a Quick Effect to Special Summon Level 3 Ultimate Insect LV3 (ready to evolve during your Standby Phase!) from your GY!
allow.Number 3: Cicada King: Rank 3 WIND Insect Xyz summoned using Level 3 Ultimate Insect LV3 + Level 3 Gokipole that negates monster effects and revives Insects.
allow.Giant Beetrooper Invincible Atlas: Link-4 Insect pinnacle boss providing effect immunity and summoning from Deck.

main: Ultimate Insect LV1

Level 1 WIND Insect: while face-up on the field, this card is completely UNAFFECTED by the effects of Spell Cards; during your Standby Phase, sends itself to the GY to Special Summon 'Ultimate Insect LV3' from your hand or Deck (activating its -300 ATK debuff!).
Ultimate Insect LV3

Core Level 3 WIND Insect (1400 ATK): if Special Summoned by the effect of Ultimate Insect LV1, all monsters your opponent controls lose 300 ATK; during your Standby Phase, sends itself to the GY to Special Summon 'Ultimate Insect LV5' from your hand or Deck (unlocking LV5's -500 ATK debuff!)!
Ultimate Insect LV5

Core Level 5 WIND Insect (2300 ATK): if Special Summoned by the effect of Ultimate Insect LV3, all monsters your opponent controls lose 500 ATK (making LV5 win against any 2800 ATK monster in battle!); during your next Standby Phase, sends itself to the GY to Special Summon 'Ultimate Insect LV7' from your hand or Deck!
Ultimate Insect LV7

Signature Level 7 WIND Insect boss (2600 ATK): if Special Summoned by the effect of Ultimate Insect LV5, all monsters your opponent controls lose 700 ATK AND 700 DEF (allowing LV7 to run over any 3300 ATK or 3300 DEF boss monster in battle while shrinking the opponent's entire board for your other Insects!).
Resonance Insect
Adds Ultimate Insect LV5 or Ultimate Insect LV7 from your Deck to your hand when sent from the field to the GY (by Insect Imitation or Inzektor Picofalena!).
Gokipole
Adds Resonance Insect or Pinch Hopper from your Deck to your hand when sent to the GY.
Pinch Hopper

When sent from your field to the GY, Special Summons any Insect monster (Ultimate Insect LV3, LV5, or LV7!) from your hand—and if triggered during your Standby Phase, lets Ultimate Insect LV3 immediately evolve into LV5!
Parasite Paranoid
Quick Effect handtrap that equips to an opponent's monster to turn it into an Insect and stop it from attacking Insects, then Special Summons Ultimate Insect LV7 from your hand when sent to the GY!
Level Up!

Core Normal Spell: sends 1 face-up 'LV' monster you control (Ultimate Insect LV1, LV3, or LV5) to the GY to immediately Special Summon the monster listed in its text (LV3, LV5, or LV7) from your hand or Deck without waiting for the Standby Phase!
Insect Imitation

Tributes Level 2 Parasite Paranoid to Special Summon Level 3 Ultimate Insect LV3 from your Deck, OR tributes Level 4 Resonance Insect/Pinch Hopper to Special Summon Level 5 Ultimate Insect LV5 from your Deck!
Cocoon of Ultra Evolution
Tributes an Insect on either field equipped with Parasite Paranoid or Picofalena's equip to Special Summon an Insect from your Deck, and recycles an Insect from your GY to draw 1 card.
extra: Link-2 WIND Insect (2 Insect monsters): equips Gokipole or Resonance Insect directly from your Deck to an Insect you control (triggering their searches when sent to the GY!), and recycles 3 used Ultimate Insects from your GY into the Deck to draw 1 card!

Link-3 WIND Insect boss: removes 1 counter as a Quick Effect during your opponent's End Phase (or your Standby Phase!) to revive Level 3 Ultimate Insect LV3 from your GY—so LV3 immediately sends itself to the GY during your Standby Phase to Special Summon Ultimate Insect LV5 with its -500 ATK effect active!
Rank 3 WIND Insect Xyz (Ultimate Insect LV3 + Gokipole) that detaches 1 material to negate an opponent's monster effect and revives an Insect when switched to Defense Position.
Link-4: 3000 ATK Insect boss immune to effects while 3000 or less ATK; tributes an Insect to summon from Deck.
